title: Cambridge IELTS 17 Test 1 Writing Task 2
directions:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Write about the following topic:
prompt:
It is important for people to take risks, both in their professional lives and their personal lives.

Do you think the advantages of taking risks outweigh the disadvantages?
scenario: It is important for people to take risks, both in their professional lives and their personal lives.
requirements: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
